name: Creosote bush
desc: Creosote bush (Larrea tridentata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 29 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Larrea tridentata, also called creosote bush, greasewood as a plant, and chaparral as a medicinal herb. In Sonora, it is more commonly called hediondilla; Spanish hediondo = "smelly".
